Skyddsrum helps you find the nearest public shelter in Sweden, fast. All shelter data is bundled in the app, so the list works without internet.

Shelter locations and capacities: Myndigheten för civilt försvar (formerly MSB), open data from the INSPIRE service \"Skyddsrum\" (no usage restrictions). Municipality names were added by matching positions to municipality borders. The data may be out of date. Always follow official information.
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
